definition: Imbago zose z’imihanda minini, amabarabara, aho abantu nyamwinshi bahurira, aho imodoka zihagarara, inzira n’utuyira two ku muhanda, ibiraro, ibyombo mbese ku buryo rusange, imihanda nyabagendwa yose igendwamo ku butaka.
Igice cyangwa ibice by’inzira nyabagendwa bigendwaho n’ibinyabiziga; iyo nzira nyabagendwa ikaba yagira imihanda myinshi itandukanyijwe ku buryo bugaragara n’ubutaka bwayo cyangwa ubusumbane.
Umuhanda n’inzira ziwukikije.

Kimwe mu bice bigabanyije umuhanda mu burebure bwawo; ariko icyo gisate kikagira ubugari buhagije ku buryo ibinyabiziga bitari amagare, velomoteri cyangwa amapikipiki bigenda bibangikanye. Bishobora kugaragazwa n’umurongo umwe ukomeje cyangwa ugizwe n’uduce dukurikiranye.
Igice cy’inzira nyabagendwa cyagenewe kunyurwamo n’amagare na velomoteri bikaragarazwa n’ikimenyetso cyabigenewe.

1. Ahantu hose imihanda ihurira; 2. Aho umuhanda wisukira mu wundi; cyangwa 3. Mu maharakubiri y’inzira nyabagendwa; ubwo hakabarirwamo imyanya igizwe n’ayo mahuriro n’izo nkomane cyangwa nayo maharakubiri y’imihanda.
Inzira nyabagendwa ifunganye yagenewe gusa abanyamaguru cyangwa ibinyabiziga bigendera ku biziga bibiri.

Inzira nyabagendwa yagutse kurusha akayira ariko ubusanzwe ikaba itaragenewe ibinyabiziga bibiri. Inzira y’igitaka ikomeza kwitwa ityo iyo isa n’umuhanda igihe irasutse gusa mu yindi nzira nyabagendwa.
1. Ahantu hose hari amazu yegeranye cyangwa afatanye ari kuruhande urwo arirwo rwose rw’inzira nyabagendwa; cyangwa se 2. Aho binjirira n’aho basohokera hagaragazwa n’ibyapa by’aho hantu.
Umuntu wese utwaye ikinyabiziga, cyangwa uyobora mu nzira nyabagendwa inyamaswa zikurura, zikorera cyangwa zigenderwaho; cyangwa amatungo, yaba ubushyo cyangwa imwe imwe.
Umwe mu bakozi bambaye kuburyo bugaragaza ibimenyetso by’imirimo ashinzwe; (urugero: abapolisi bo mu mutwe ushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda).
Ikintu cyose gikoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu ku butaka; kimwe n’igikoresho cyose kigendeshwa gihingishwa, gikoreshwa mu nganda cyangwa ahandi.
Ikinyabiziga cyose, nk’igare ry’ikiziga 1, 2, 3, cyangwa bine kigendeshwa n’ingufu z’abantu bakiriho; nko kuba bakoresha ibirenge cyangwa intoki.

a) Igare: Ikinyamitende cy’ibiziga bibiri. b) Velomoteri: Ikinyabiziga gifite ibiziga bitarenze bibiri, kandi gifite moteri itarengeje santimetero kibe 50 cyangwa imbaraga zitarenga KvA4 (Kaveya), icyindi kandi hakurikijwe uko cyakozwe, umuvuduko wacyo nturenge km 60 mu isaha. N.B: Igare na Velomoteri bidahetse ababigendaho ntibibarwa nk’ibinyabiziga.
Ikinyabiziga cyose cy’ibiziga bibiri gifite moteri, ukuyemo za Velomoteri.

term: Ikinyamitende itatu n’ikinyamitende ine bifite moteri
definition: Ibinyabiziga by’ibiziga bitatu cyangwa bine bitarengeje uburemere bw’ibiro 400, kandi moteri ikaba itarengeje santimetero kibe 350 cyangwa imbaraga zayo zikaba zitarengeje KvA15. N.B: Gushyira intebe kuruhande cyangwa rumoroki inyuma yibi binyabiziga ntacyo bihindura kurwego birimo.
Ikinyabiziga cyose gifite moteri kigendesha kandi kigendeshwa n’ibikigize.

Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa na moteri, uretse velomoteri, ipikipiki, ibinyamitende itatu cyangwa ine bifite moteri, n’imashini zihinga n’izindi zikurura zifite moteri; zikaba kandi ku busanzwe zitwara munzira nyabagendwa abantu cyangwa ibintu cg se zigenewe gukurura ibindi binyabiziga bitwara abantu cyangwa ibintu.
Ikinyabiziga kigenewe gukururwa n’ikindi; iryo jambo rikoreshwa no kuri za Makuzungu.

Romoruki iyo ari yo yose yagenewe gufatishwa ku kinyabiziga gikurura kuburyo igice cyayo kiba kiyiryamyeho, kandi igice cy’uburemere bwacyo ndetse n’ubw’ibyo itwaye bukaba bushikamiye icyo kinyabiziga.
Rumoruki iyo ariyo yose ifite uburemere butarenga ibiro 750 (750 kg).
Ibinyabiziga bifatanye bikagenda nk’aho ari kimwe.
Ikinyabiziga gikomatanye, kimwe ari ikinyabiziga gikurura ikindi ari makuzungu.
Bivuga ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bikururana bigizwe n’ikinyabiziga gifatanije kandi kiriho romoroki yacyo.

term_fr: Poids à vide et poids non chargé
definition: Uburemere bw’ikinyabiziga kizima n’ibikoresho byacyo ngombwa hatabariwemo abagitwaye, abantu cg imizigo cyikoreye; gifite karisori kandi cyuzuye lisansi, mazutu cg gazi, amazi n’amavuta.
Uburemere bwite bw’ikinyabiziga kizima hongereweho uburemere bw’imizigo cyikoreye, ubw’ugitwaye n’ubw’umuntu wese gitwaye.

Uburemere bwose ntarengwa bw’ikinyabiziga bwemejwe hakurikijwe ibivugwa muri iri teka n’uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bw’ibinyabiziga bikomatanye, bw’ikinyabiziga gifatanije cg bw’ikinyabiziba gikururana kabiri, bwitwa nanone Uburemere bugendanwa.
Igihe cya ngombwa ikinyabiziga kimara gihagaze kugirango abantu cg ibintu byinjire cyangwa bisohoke.
Igihe kirenze icya ngombwa ikinyabiziga kimara gihagaze kugirango abantu cg ibintu byinjire cg bisohoke.
Akantu karabagirana gasubiza imirasire y’urumuri ku kintu kiyohereje.
Ibinyabiziga by’abapolisi, ibizimya-nkongi ndetse n’ibinyabiziga bitwara abarwayi, iyo bijya aho bigomba gutabara byihutirwa; kandi bikarangwa n’intabaza irabagirana cg irangurura ijwi.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga amurika umuhanda mu ntambwe ndende, imbere y’icyo kinyabiziga.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga amurika inzira nyabagendwa imbere y’icyo kinyabiziga bitagombye guhuma cyangwa kubangamira abayobozi bava mucyerekezo.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga akiranga, kandi agaragaza ubugari bwacyo burebewe imbere.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga akiranga, kandi yerekana ubugari bwacyo kirebewe inyuma.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga abonesha neza inzira imbere yacyo igihe: 1. cy’igihu, 2. cy’imvura nyinshi, 3. cy’urubura cg 4. cy’umukungugu.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga akiranga kandi yerekana ubugari bwacyo kirebewe inyuma igihe: 1. cy’igihu, 2. cy’imvura nyinshi, 3. cy’urubura cg 4. cy’umukungugu.
Amatara y’ikinyabiziga agenewe 1. Kubonesha inzira inyuma y’ikinyabiziga no 2. Kumenyesha abandi bagenzi ko ikinyabiziga gisubira inyuma; cyangwa 3. Kigiye gusubira inyuma.
Itara ry’ikinyabiziga rigonewe kwereka abandi bagenzi ko umuyobozi ashaka kugana iburyo cyangwa ibumoso.
Itara ry’ikinyabiziga gishobora guhindukizwa n’umuyobozi bidatewe n’uko ikinyabiziga kigenda, kandi rishobora kumurika ikintu kiri munzira nyabagendwa cyangwa hirya yayo.
Itara ry’ikinyabiziga ryerekana ubugari bwacyo, ahagana imbere cyangwa inyuma igihe uburebure bwacyo burenga metero 6 cyangwa iyo ubugari bwacyo, habariwemo ibyo cyikoreye burenga metero 2.10.
Kubyerekeye amatara: Ni ubuso busohokana urumuri naho kubyerekeye utugarurarumuri bikavuga: Ubuso burabagiranamo urumuri.
Itara ryose ry’umuhondo winganje; ry’umuhondo nyawo cyangwa usa n’icunga hakurikijwe ibisobanuro bivugwa ku mugereka wa 7 w’iri teka.
